crossRefs.note: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”
Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things,
Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

parallels.note: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

people.name: Elijah
people.line: A prophet during the reigns of Ahab and Ahaziah.

translations.web: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”
translations.bsb: When some of those standing nearby heard this, they said, “Behold, He is calling Elijah.”
translations.kjv: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elias.
translations.asv: And some of them that stood by, when they heard it, said, Behold, he calleth Elijah.
